Docs.summary: GPU count for GPU pools or vCPU count for CPU pools. Must be 1, 2, 4, 8, or a positive multiple of 8. Omit to preserve the current value; null clears the override to use the full node or the instance type's default count. Full-node Azure VM sizes permit partition selection. A supplied count must match an exact Singularity instance type; the Singularity.D4_v3 fallback accepts 4.
